questions.question: At which ground did Western Province record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 109, against Badgers on 2024/12/15.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Matches Played' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Paulinah Mashishi holds it, with a total of 67, a joint record shared with Robyn Searle.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Dolphins or Dragons?
At which ground did Simone Lourens record their career-best innings (102, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Wanderers, against Lions on 2023/10/14.

questions.question: "Warriors" is the current name for which former provincial union?
At Kimberley Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Michaela van Vuuren holds it with 16.
